caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain, light beige background. The chair has a light to medium brown color with subtle variations in tone indicating wood grain. It features a ladder-back design, with four horizontal, slightly curved slats forming the backrest, each slat having two symmetrical cut-out shapes. The seat is woven from a material represented in a warm, golden-brown hue, indicating a rush or straw texture arranged in a chevron pattern. The chair legs are sturdy and rectangular, joined by horizontal stretchers on all four sides. The composition is centered, with nothing else besides the chair visible in the drawing, and the artist's name, "Ruth Bialacotasky," is written in cursive in the lower left corner.
title: Side Chair (one of a pair)
